name.value: Japanese Village Teppan Steak & Seafood House

description.value: Japanese Village is a long-established teppanyaki restaurant in downtown Victoria where personal chefs cook steak and seafood on a searing iron grill right at the table — part culinary performance, part dinner. Voted Best Japanese Restaurant in Victoria since 1994 by Black Press Media readers, the restaurant features an extensive sake and cocktail bar alongside its signature teppan dinners. Takeout is available by phone, and a dedicated children's menu makes it a flexible option for touring groups stopping in the city.
